name: Cloudflare Hyperdrive Free
free_limit: 100,000 database SQL statements/day through Hyperdrive on Workers Free; up to 10 configured databases/account
watch_out: Each SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE and schema statement counts toward the daily limit (resets 00:00 UTC); over-limit queries fail rather than becoming unlimited. Hyperdrive requires a separately operated PostgreSQL/MySQL origin and a Worker: origin hosting and paid Workers resources are NOT included.
